Grassland species Alien species all variables signiﬁcant variables all variables signiﬁcant variables Total 1 1 1 1 Constrained 0.52 0.36 0.42 0.25 Unconstrained 0.48 0.64 0.58 0.75 doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0142236.t005 Discussion The main result of this study is that grassland and alien plant species may favor power line cor- ridors with somewhat different characteristics, but the effects of individual environmental fac- tors on the species composition in the two groups are correlated. Grassland species on power line corridors According to this study, urban power line corridors most suitable to common grassland species are characterized by a history of pastures and productive soils on steep slopes, while corridors most suitable to grassland indicator species are old and likewise characterized by a history of pastures and steep slopes.
